outbreak_frequency: SEFI pediatric cohort (~6,000 children, 4 urban settlements) under active surveillance Oct 2017-Dec 2019; outbreak (Apr-Jun 2019) detected as cases exceeding mean+2SD of surveillance counts in corresponding months of prior years 2017-2018, implying continuous sporadic/endemic transmission; no other prior outbreak explicitly described
endemicity: Described as typhoid-endemic setting with suboptimal WaSH; short- and long-cycle S. Typhi transmission; only 8.6% of cohort vaccinated
seasonality: Hot season Mar-Jul (May/June max temp 42C/39.2C 2019); majority of outbreak cases in May; water scarcity in summer proposed driver of seasonal surge
notes: Overall cohort attack rate 0.9% (outbreak period); ref.4 (John 2018) is the source SEFI/NSSEFI incidence paper, not detailed here; H58 lineage II S. Typhi
